title: Constant-temperature efficient air energy water heater
abstract: The utility model discloses a constant-temperature high-efficiency air energy water heater, which relates to the technical field of air energy water heaters and comprises a water heater body, wherein a heat exchange assembly is arranged inside the water heater body, a water delivery pipe is connected below the heat exchange assembly, the bottom end of the water delivery pipe is connected with a constant temperature box arranged on the inner wall of the water heater body, the bottom end of the constant temperature box is provided with a temperature regulating box, the end surface of the temperature regulating box is connected with a water inlet pipe, the bottom end of the temperature regulating box is provided with a constant temperature box, the inner wall of the constant temperature box is provided with a water outlet control valve, the inner wall of the constant temperature box is provided with a water outlet cavity connected with an output port of the water outlet control valve, and the water outlet cavity is internally provided with a water outlet cavity. The constant-temperature water tank effectively solves the problem of inconvenient use of a user due to different water temperatures in the constant-temperature tank through the water inlet pipe, the electric control valve, the temperature regulating tank, the input pipe, the output pipe, the water pump and the constant-temperature tank; the precision of the temperature sensor is improved through the impeller, the stirring shaft and the stirring blade.

title: Combined vacuumizing system of hydrogen peroxide production line
abstract: The utility model discloses a combined type vacuumizing system of a hydrogen peroxide production line, wherein an outlet of a vacuumizing main pipe is connected with an air extracting opening of a Roots vacuum pump, an air exhaust opening of the Roots vacuum pump is connected with an air extracting opening of a liquid ring vacuum pump in series, an air exhaust opening of the liquid ring vacuum pump is connected with a top air inlet on the left side of a gas-liquid separation tank, an air exhaust opening on the right side of the gas-liquid separation tank is connected with a tail gas collecting device, a vertical middle partition plate is arranged in an inner cavity of the gas-liquid separation tank to divide the tank body into a left cavity and a right cavity, an overflow channel is reserved between the middle partition plate and the tank top, a pure water supplementing pipe is connected into the left cavity of the gas-liquid separation tank through a pure water supplementing valve, a water outlet on the lower portion of the left cavity of the gas-liquid separation tank is connected with a hot side inlet of a cooler through a filter, a hot side outlet of the cooler is connected with a working liquid inlet of the liquid ring vacuum pump, and a water outlet on the bottom of the right cavity of the gas-liquid separation tank is connected with a waste water discharging pipe through a waste water discharging valve. The system can improve the vacuum degree and the air extraction efficiency, realize the automatic adjustment of the vacuum degree and the automatic separation and discharge of waste liquid, and simultaneously reduce the energy consumption.

title: Polyacrylonitrile raw liquid ammonia gasification ventilation device
abstract: The utility model relates to a polyacrylonitrile primary liquid ammonia breather for the ammonia is let in to the polyacrylonitrile primary liquid conveyer pipe, the polyacrylonitrile primary liquid ammonia breather includes: the tank body is provided with a containing cavity, heat-insulating water is contained in the containing cavity, and a water inlet and a water outlet which are communicated with the containing cavity are formed in the shell of the tank body; the air bag is arranged in the tank body, and the volume of the air bag is variable; the first gas transmission pipeline is used for transmitting ammonia gas from outside the tank body to the air bag in the tank body; the second gas transmission pipeline is used for transmitting ammonia gas from the air bag to the polyacrylonitrile stock solution conveying pipe. The temperature and the pressure of the ammonia flowing through the first gas transmission pipeline and the air bag can be controlled by controlling the temperature and the pressure of the heat-insulating water in the tank body, so that the temperature and the pressure of the ammonia flowing into the polyacrylonitrile raw liquid conveying pipe are stable, the ammonia metering is ensured to be accurate, the ammoniation modification degree of the polyacrylonitrile raw liquid is kept consistent, and the quality stability of a final formed product is improved.

title: Special fresh air sand removing and cooling device for incubation
abstract: The utility model relates to a special new trend of hatching removes sand heat sink. The front end of the special fresh air sand-removing and cooling device for incubation is connected with an outdoor air inlet through an air pipe; the rear part of the air inlet is connected with a fresh air inlet of an original equipment layer; wherein, hatching special new trend heat sink that removes sand includes: the outer shell comprises an air inlet, a spraying cavity and an air outlet, and a drain outlet is arranged below the spraying cavity; the fresh air primary filter is connected to an air inlet of the outer shell; the air distribution plate is arranged in the outer shell and is positioned behind the fresh air primary filter; the spraying structure is arranged in the outer shell and is positioned behind the air distributing plate; the spraying structure comprises: a circulating water pump is arranged in the water tank; the water inlet pipe is connected with a water filter and is connected with a built-in circulating water pump; at least two rows of spray headers which are respectively connected with the water outlet end of the built-in circulating water pump; the water baffle and the primary effect structure are arranged at the air outlet of the outer shell, and the air is discharged through the water baffle and the primary effect structure.

title: Atmosphere control device and Ma Fushi bright heat treatment furnace with same
abstract: The utility model discloses an atmosphere control device and Ma Fushi bright heat treatment furnace with the same, wherein the atmosphere control device is arranged between a furnace body and a hydrogen main air inlet pipeline and comprises a humidifying storage tank, a humidifying cavity is limited in the humidifying storage tank and used for containing humidifying liquid, an air inlet, a liquid supplementing port and a liquid discharging port which are communicated with the humidifying cavity are arranged at the bottom of the humidifying storage tank, an air outlet and an air outlet are arranged at the top of the humidifying storage tank, a multistage decompression regulation bypass is arranged at the bottom of the humidifying storage tank, the multistage decompression regulation bypass is communicated between the hydrogen main air inlet pipeline and the air inlet of the humidifying storage tank, and the multistage decompression regulation bypass comprises a decompression pipe and a plurality of decompression valves which are arranged on the decompression pipe in series and used for decompressing gas conveyed by the hydrogen main air inlet pipeline to working pressure in multiple stages. The utility model has the beneficial effects of accurately regulating and controlling atmosphere and humidity atmosphere, avoiding the phenomenon of steel sticking scratch and reducing the polishing cost of the appearance of the product.

title: Customer service scoring model construction method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application relates to a customer service scoring model construction method, a customer service scoring model construction device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of unlabeled customer service data, real label information thereof and a plurality of identification teacher networks, and identifying each customer service data and data types of each identification teacher network; based on the recognition teacher network, predicting pseudo tag information of each customer service data, and screening target customer service data corresponding to noise values lower than a noise threshold; generating a transition probability matrix of the data type based on transition probability information between pseudo tag information and real tag information of each target customer service data; training an initial recognition student model through a knowledge distillation loss function based on the information to obtain a recognition student model corresponding to the data type; and obtaining a scoring strategy of each data type, thereby constructing a customer service scoring model. By adopting the method, the training efficiency of the customer service scoring model can be improved.

title: Combined modeling method, system and medium based on financial data
abstract: The application provides a joint modeling method, a system and a medium based on financial data, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining original data of different participants, and converting the original data into standard data in a unified format according to a standard template; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a verification result corresponding to each participant through verification of standard data by a verification tool, encrypting the verification result, sending the verification result to a coordinator, decrypting and verifying the encrypted verification result by the coordinator, initializing a global model by the coordinator after verification is passed, sending initial parameters of the global model to each participant, respectively carrying out model training on the global model by the standard data of each participant to obtain an updated model, and taking the current updated model as a target model after the updated model is determined to meet the requirements.

title: Financial data accounting method, device, equipment and storage medium based on equity
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a financial data accounting method, device, equipment and storage medium based on equity, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a financial accounting instruction; determining a target object to be accounted and inquiring employment information; selecting different accounting strategies according to different occupational states; if the occupation state is in-position, calling a first accounting strategy; acquiring reserved associated information and first target information from the employment information, and calling a first calculation formula; calculating the accumulated cost to be confirmed; if the occupation state is retired, calling a second accounting strategy; executing a second accounting strategy, acquiring second target information, and calling a second calculation formula; the cumulative cost to be confirmed is calculated. According to the method, the employees in different occupational states are divided into different accounting types, the system computing logic is optimized, the data computing efficiency is improved, and the cost amortization condition can be accurately accounted during statistics for different employees with shares for a long time.

title: Combined optimization method and device for asset delivery, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a combination optimization method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for asset delivery. The method comprises the steps of obtaining order demand parameters, reading asset data meeting order demands in a database according to the order demand parameters, obtaining overlap relations among the asset data, integrating the overlap relations to obtain an asset list, inputting the asset list into a preset integer programming model, and solving according to preset constraint conditions and preset objective functions of the integer programming model to determine target assets needing to be delivered. By applying the integer programming model, only the asset data is transmitted, the proper target asset can be automatically solved, the optimal solution can be obtained at the second level, the speed of obtaining the result is greatly improved, the asset matching efficiency can be effectively improved, the quick utilization of the asset is realized, the unified measurement standard is provided, and the optimal solution can be obtained for a plurality of similar matching results according to the measurement standard, so that the solving result has higher quality.

title: Traffic accident and offence bailiff condition data analysis and judgment method and system based on large model
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and provides a traffic accident and violation bailiff condition data analysis and judgment method and system based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving first query information which is input by a user and relates to traffic accident and violation bailiff condition data analysis and judgment; when the information density of the query information is determined to be high-concentration query, supplementing one or more of implicit accident types, time interval ranges, comparison dimensions or multi-place aggregation requirements in the query information based on a traffic knowledge base to obtain enriched second query information, determining the decomposition necessity of the second query information, when the decomposition necessity exceeds a threshold value, decomposing the second query information into a plurality of third query information with dependence, wherein each third query information corresponds to a single statistical index, a single time interval or a single place, and generating a research and judgment result based on a large model and the third query information. The method can accurately identify the implicit requirements of the high-concentration query, and improve the efficiency and accuracy of analysis, study and judgment of the police condition data.

title: Electrical structure and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a substrate; a first insulation layer disposed over a first surface of the substrate; a second insulation layer disposed on the first insulation layer; and an electrical contact extending through the first and second insulation layers to electrically connect to the first surface of the substrate. The electrical contact includes a first portion disposed in the first insulation layer and a second portion disposed in the second insulation layer, the first portion has a first width, the second portion has a second width, and a ratio of a difference between the first width and the second width to the first width is less than 10%; at least one isolation feature extending into the substrate and disposed below the first surface of the substrate; and at least one conductive feature extending through the second insulation layer and the first insulation layer and into the substrate.

title: Optical sensing device and electronic apparatus having the same
abstract: An optical sensing device includes a substrate, a sensing element layer, a light-shielding layer and a light absorbing layer. The substrate has a first surface and a second surface opposite to the first surface. The sensing element layer is disposed on the first surface and includes a plurality of sensing elements. The light-shielding layer is disposed on the sensing element layer and has a plurality of openings, wherein an orthogonal projection of the opening on the substrate is overlapped with an orthogonal projection of the sensing element on the substrate. The light absorbing layer is disposed on the second surface. An electronic apparatus including the optical sensing device described above is also provided.

title: Microelectromechanical button device and corresponding waterproof user interface element
abstract: A microelectromechanical button device (5) is provided with a detection structure (14) having: a substrate (22) of semiconductor material with a front surface (22a) and a rear surface (22b); a buried electrode (28) arranged on the substrate; a mobile electrode (32), arranged in a structural layer (30) overlying the substrate and elastically suspended above the buried electrode at a separation distance so as to form a detection capacitor (Cd); and a cap (46) coupled over the structural layer and having a first main surface (46a) facing the structural layer and a second main surface (46b) that is designed to be mechanically coupled to a deformable portion (3) of a case (2) of an electronic apparatus (1) of a portable or wearable type. The cap has, on its first main surface, an actuation portion (48) arranged over the mobile electrode and configured to cause, in the presence of a pressure applied on the second main surface, a deflection of the mobile electrode and its approach to the buried electrode, with a consequent capacitive variation of the detection capacitor, which is indicative of an actuation of the microelectromechanical button device.

title: Optical semiconductor element, optical unit and method for manufacturing optical unit
abstract: To simply and efficiently introduce light into a waveguide member.SOLUTION: An optical semiconductor element 10 includes: a semiconductor substrate 2 having a first main surface 2a and a second main surface 2b on the side opposite to the first main surface 2a; a laminate 3 formed on the first main surface 2a and including an active layer 33 and a contact layer 35 arranged on the side opposite to the semiconductor substrate 2 to the active layer 33; a first electrode 4 contacting the contact layer 35; and a second electrode 5 formed on the second main surface 2b. The laminate 3 includes a light transmission part 36 formed without covering at least a part 350 of a surface 35a on the side opposite to the semiconductor substrate 2 in the contact layer 35 with the first electrode 4. The optical semiconductor element 10 is constituted so as not to form a waveguide mode by current application through the first electrode 4 and a second electrode 5 in the state that the light transmission part 36 is optically in non-contact with an external member.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Self-light-emitting panel, display device, and manufacturing method for self-light-emitting panel
abstract: To provide a structure for homogenizing the thickness of a functional layer in a self-light-emitting panel in which the functional layer is formed in a wet process, and a manufacturing method for the same.SOLUTION: A self-light-emitting panel includes a substrate, a plurality of partition walls, a plurality of base layers including a first electrode and arranged in a gap between the two adjacent partition walls, an interpixel regulation layer covering a gap between the two base layers that are adjacent in a first direction, a functional layer serving as an application film disposed on the base layer in the gap between the partition walls, and a second electrode disposed over the functional layer. Each of the base layers includes a recess on an upper surface. The base layers include a particular base layer that is not covered with the interpixel regulation layer corresponding to at least a part of the recess on the upper surface, include a groove continuing from an end on the particular base layer side to another base layer on the upper surface of the interpixel regulation layer, and include an application layer formed of the same material as the functional layer in the recess on the upper surface of the particular base layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title: Composition and methods for identification of novel aav variants for differentiated gene delivery to cardiomyoctes and/or skeletal myofibers
abstract: The present invention relates to the provision of recombinant adeno-associated virus (rAAV) -based delivery vectors comprising short peptide inserts of at least 5 amino acid length, which show enhanced transduction efficiency in one or more muscle cells, particularly in cardiomyocytes and/or skeletal muscle cells. The rAAV vectors of the present disclosure are suitable for use in the treatment and/or prophylaxis of a cardiac-related and/or muscle-related disease or disorder and/or for use in gene therapy. Also provided are methods of treating cardiac-related and/or muscle-related diseases or disorders.

title: Methods and compositions for targeting pd-l1
abstract: The present disclosure relates to small interfering RNA (siRNA) molecules directed to mRNA transcripts of CD274 to cause downregulation of programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression in humans. The siRNA can be constructed of unmodified nucleotides or modified nucleotides that exhibit modified sugars, nucleobases, linkages, or covalently bound targeting moieties. Also disclosed herein are pharmaceutical compositions of siRNAs and uses of or methods of using the siRNAs for the treatment of PD-L1 related diseases including but not limited to liver diseases, cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, viral diseases, or hepatitis B.

title: Ma Dexin derivative compounds, compositions and uses thereof for the treatment of cancer
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of medicine, in particular cancer therapy. More particularly, the present invention relates to novel compounds which are generally used as medicaments. In particular, the invention relates to the use of these novel compounds for increasing the presentation, typically the production and presentation, of an antigen of advanced translational product (PTP) origin by cells, in particular cancer cells, or for altering the immune peptide group in a subject and for inducing or stimulating an immune response in said subject. The disclosure also relates to the use of such compounds, in particular for preparing a pharmaceutical composition and/or allowing or improving the efficiency of a therapy in a subject in need thereof. Also disclosed are methods for treating a disease, particularly cancer, preventing or treating metastasis and/or recurrence of cancer in a subject. Furthermore, the invention provides kits suitable for use in preparing a composition according to the invention and/or for performing the methods described herein.

title: Compositions and methods for treating diseases associated with pathogenic FUS variants
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of antisense oligonucleotides for reducing the expression of selected alleles of a FUS gene encoding the protein FUS or variants thereof. The invention also provides pharmaceutical compositions and methods of treating disease effects associated with pathogenic FUS genetic variants by administering antisense oligonucleotides and therapeutic compositions comprising AONs that target FUS or variants thereof.

title: Patatin-like phospholipase domain containing 3 (pnpla3) irna compositions and methods of use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to RNAi agents, e.g. , double stranded RNA (dsRNA) agents, targeting the Patatin-Like Phospholipase Domain Containing 3 (PNPLA3) gene. The invention also relates to methods of using such RNAi agents to inhibit expression of a PNPLA3 gene and to methods of preventing and treating an PNPLA3-associated disorder, e.g. , Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD).

title: Oxygen-enriched vacancy Bi12O17Cl2Ultrathin nanosheets, preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an oxygen-enriched vacancy Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 ultrathin nanosheet and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of inorganic functional materials. According to the invention, the Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 material is constructed through the combined action of the bismuth-rich strategy and the defect engineering, so that the polarization electric field of the material is promoted to be increased, and active oxygen species are increased, and the Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 material shows excellent photocatalytic performance. The preparation of the Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 material specifically comprises the following steps: bismuth nitrate pentahydrate, polyvinylpyrrolidone and mannitol are dissolved in deionized water, then saturated sodium chloride solution and 1, 3-propylene diamine are added for hydrothermal reaction, and the obtained product is washed and freeze-dried to prepare the Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 material. The Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 material has good photocatalytic degradation performance and wide application range, has a degradation rate of 99.9% for methyl orange, cresol red, bromocresol green, methyl red and rhodamine B, has a degradation rate of 93.1% for bisphenol A, and has good practical application value.

title: Black titanium dioxide optical nano material rich in oxygen vacancy defects and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a titanium dioxide nano material rich in oxygen vacancy defects, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductor photocatalysts. The preparation method adopts a method combining sol-gel and solid phase synthesis, and the method comprises the steps of dissolving soluble titanium salt and then adding alkaline solution to obtain precipitate; then reacting the precipitate with a reducing agent to obtain titanium dioxide precursor gel with electronegative groups; sintering the titanium dioxide precursor gel with electronegative groups in inert gas to obtain the pure titanium dioxide nano material rich in oxygen vacancy defects. The titanium dioxide nano material which is rich in oxygen vacancy defects and prepared by the preparation method has the oxygen vacancy content of 8 percent, the energy band gap of 1.94eV, and has higher photocatalytic activity compared with other titanium dioxide. The method has the advantages of green, simplicity, high purity, strong safety, energy conservation, environmental protection and large-scale mass production, and the material can be applied to the fields of organic dye degradation, gas purification and the like.

title: Hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of fine chemical engineering, and discloses hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch comprises the steps of mixing starch and water to prepare starch milk, adding sodium phytate and urea, cooling, adding sodium sulfate and sodium hydroxide, adding propylene oxide to react, and adding sodium trimetaphosphate to react to prepare the hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch. The hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch prepared by the preparation method has excellent shearing resistance, acid resistance and oxidation resistance.

title: Ovalbumin loaded nitro-radical oxynitride nanocomposite and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an ovalbumin-loaded nitro-radical nitrogen oxide nanocomposite and a preparation method and application thereof. Belonging to the technical field of material preparation. The nitro radical nitrogen oxide nano composite material has regular shape, average grain diameter of 100nm-150nm and good dispersivity. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving chitosan and tetramethylpiperidine-nitrogen oxide in water and dichloromethane or dimethyl sulfoxide respectively, stirring to dissolve completely, mixing, dialyzing after the reaction is finished, washing with ultrapure water after the dialysis is finished, centrifuging, and dispersing in ultrapure water. In addition, the ovalbumin is loaded on the nitro radical nitroxide nanocomposite, so that the immunogenicity of the nanocomposite can be endowed. The material prepared by the method has a nuclear magnetic resonance imaging enhancement effect and potential as an immunoadjuvant.

title: Mixed-dimension S-doped g-C3N4Base van der waals heterojunction photocatalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a mixed dimension S-doped g-C 3 N 4 A base van der Waals heterojunction photocatalyst, a preparation method and an application thereof belong to the technical field of material preparation. Dissolving melamine and cyanuric acid by dimethyl sulfoxide respectively to obtain clear solutions; the solution of melamine acid was added dropwise to the melamine solution to give as g-C 3 N 4 White precipitate of the basic van der waals heterojunction photocatalyst precursor; mixing the white precipitate precursor with trithiocyanuric acid, and calcining the mixed substance in a muffle furnace to obtain mixed dimension S-doped g-C 3 N 4 A base van der waals heterojunction photocatalyst. The catalyst can be applied to the field of photocatalysis, and the method can be obtained by changing reaction conditionsg-C doped with S in different proportions 3 N 4 The van der waals heterojunction photocatalyst has the advantages of simple process operation, stable structure and high repeatability, and can meet the requirements of laboratories and industries.

title: Field-selectable dynamic gain control mode for optical sensors
abstract: Apparatus, and an associated method, relates to a field selectable gain mode system. In an illustrative example, for example, an APD-based sensor can have two or more predetermined gain modes. For example, the gain mode may be activated in response to a user-generated selection signal. For example, APD-based sensors can apply a user-selected gain pattern by independently controlling circuit gain, transmitter gain, and APD gain. When a user selection signal is selected, for example, the controller can apply corresponding independent gain parameters to the circuit gain, transmitter gain, and APD gain, thereby providing an integrated high dynamic range sensor system. For example, the independent gain parameters may include a range of control voltages, a range of control currents, and/or a range of gain inputs. Various embodiments may advantageously achieve increased accuracy over an extended operating range of gain values.

title: System and method for an integrated control of smart home and building based on an add on scheme using knx protocol
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for the integrated control of a smart home and building based on an add-on scheme using KNX protocol. The system comprises: an artificial intelligence (AI) speaker which receives voice input and converts the same into digital signals; an AI server which receives the voice input, which has been converted into digital signals and is transmitted from the AI speaker through a communication network, analyzes the voice input and generates a floor indicator panel (FIP) control signal for at least one device to be controlled; an FIP which is installed on each floor of a building, receives an FIP control signal for the at least one device to be controlled, which is installed in each room or office, from the AI server, and converts the received control signal into a control signal for each controller; a main controller which is installed in each room or office and receives a control signal for a controller from the FIP; and at least one expanded controller which is connected in series to the main controller, receives a control signal from the main controller, and transmits a control signal for controlling the corresponding device to be controlled to the corresponding device to be controlled. The at least one expanded controller includes at least one sensor and transmits sensing information, which is generated based on a signal detected by the at least one sensor, to the AI server through the main controller. Therefore, various building loads can be controlled in connection with an interactive home and building load control speaker.

title: Receiving device
abstract: To provide a receiving device that can suppress increase of a device scale and power consumption to match time between a first information signal and a second information signal which are acquired from two pieces of broadcasting being simultaneously broadcasted.SOLUTION: A receiving device comprises: a first demodulation circuit and a second demodulation circuit that demodulate a first information signal and a second information signal representing an image or voice respectively from two broadcasting waves which are broadcasted simultaneously, to output; a delay circuit that delays the first information signal to output; a mixing circuit that generates a reception information signal on the basis of the first information signal output from the delay circuit and the second information signal; and a delay control unit 20 that generates a delay control signal on the basis of the first information signal and the second information signal. The delay control unit comprises: a first frequency band intensity calculation unit 222; a second frequency band intensity calculation unit 232; and a delay signal generation unit 250.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Methods and systems for signal interpretation via image analysis
abstract: A signal interpretation system includes a communication device, a memory storing instructions, and one or more processors configured to execute the instructions to perform operations including: receiving scanned information including a shape of at least one article scanned with a scanning device to identify the at least one article and identifying a geographic location of the scanning device, when a scan of the at least one article was performed, based on a location signal received from the scanning device. The operations also include evaluating a signal indicative of interest in the identified at least one article and transmitting, via the communication device, a notification based on the evaluated signal, the notification being indicative of the identified at least one article and the identified geographic location, the notification being configured to cause an update in at least one graphical element presented by the scanning device or another device.

title: Cold backup computer with high integrity of power supply and instructions
abstract: An aspect of the present disclosure relates to a cold-standby computer architecture including an instruction calculation module to receive a standby activation signal and control a first power switch based on the received standby activation signal, an interface management/communication module to receive the standby activation signal and control a second power switch based on the received standby activation signal, a power interface to activate from a cold standby state to provide power to one or more external units when both the first and second power switches are closed, and an interface chip module to activate from the cold standby state to communicate with the one or more external units when both the first and second power switches are closed, wherein the instruction calculation module determines a control law function output signal according to a control law and communicates the control law function output signal to the interface chip module through the interface management/communication module. Other aspects also include corresponding methods, and the like.

title: Material receiving device convenient for discharging
abstract: The utility model discloses a receiving device convenient for discharging, which relates to the technical field of discharging equipment and comprises a receiving hopper fixedly arranged on a supporting frame, wherein the bottom end of the receiving hopper is provided with a mounting shell, a pull plate is connected in a sliding manner in the mounting shell, one end of the pull plate is provided with a fixed rod, two pull ropes are arranged on the fixed rod, an electric push rod for driving the fixed rod is arranged on the mounting shell, a cross rod is arranged on the pull plate in a sliding manner, two ends of the cross rod are provided with sliding grooves for the pull ropes to penetrate through, a first spring and a second spring are sleeved outside the pull ropes, the first spring is fixedly connected between the cross rod and the inner wall of the receiving hopper, the second spring is positioned inside the sliding grooves and is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the sliding grooves, the other end of the second spring is provided with a triangular clamping block, the free ends of the two pull ropes are respectively fixedly connected with the two triangular clamping blocks, and a guide mechanism for angle adjustment is arranged on the inner side of the cross rod, and the inner side of the receiving hopper is provided with a guide mechanism for angle adjustment.

title: Alarm bell convenient to dismantle
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of alarm bells and discloses an alarm bell convenient to detach, which comprises an alarm bell body, wherein the top end of the alarm bell body is fixedly connected with an alarm bell seat, the top end of the alarm bell seat is provided with a hanging mechanism, the hanging mechanism comprises two hanging angle blocks, the upper ends of the back surfaces of the two hanging angle blocks are respectively fixedly connected with a hanging inserting rod, the hanging mechanism also comprises two butt joint supporting seats, the lower ends of the front surfaces of the two butt joint supporting seats are respectively provided with a butt joint inserting hole, the upper ends of the two butt joint supporting seats are respectively movably inserted with a limiting pin rod, the front surfaces of the two limiting pin rods are respectively provided with a stable pressing plate, and the outer walls of the rear ends of the two limiting pin rods are respectively movably sleeved with a reset pressing spring. The hanging mechanism is arranged, so that the device can be stably fixed on the roof, the functions of convenient disassembly and installation of the device are effectively realized, and meanwhile, the device is simple in structure, easy to operate and convenient to disassemble for daily maintenance.

title: Belt cleaning device is used in production of screw with screening effect
abstract: The utility model discloses a cleaning device with a screening function for screw production, and relates to the technical field of screw production equipment; the turntable is arranged in the box body above the adjusting frame; the poke rods are a plurality of and are respectively and vertically fixed on the bottom surface of the turntable, and the poke rods are all meshed with the tooth grooves; an output shaft of the driving motor passes through the top surface of the box body through a bearing in a rotating manner and is fixedly connected with the middle part of the turntable; the rotating ring is movably embedded on the peripheral wall of the rotating disc, and runners are arranged in the rotating disc and the poke rod and communicated with the spray head; the screen plate is arranged on the bottom surface of the supporting box; the upper end of the first electric push rod is hinged with the inner top surface of the groove, and the lower end of the first electric push rod is hinged with the upper side surface of the screen plate; the box door is rotatably arranged on the opening end of the right side wall of the box body through a hinge; automatic washing and screening operation, the operation is more simple and convenient, simultaneously, washs and the screening integration sets up, simple structure, and is small, and the practicality is stronger.

title: Seam welder convenient to use
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of welding, in particular to a seam welder convenient to use, which comprises a supporting seat, wherein a bidirectional screw rod is arranged in the supporting seat, and a first driving component is arranged on the bidirectional screw rod; two ends of the bidirectional screw are connected with sliding plates, the sliding plates are connected with the support frame through connecting blocks, a sliding groove is formed in the top of the support frame, and a movable welding mechanism is mounted on the sliding groove; the mobile welding mechanism comprises a sliding block, the sliding block is connected with a sliding chute through a guide assembly, a one-way screw is connected inside the sliding block, an installation frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the sliding block, the installation frame is connected with a gear connecting piece through a rotating shaft, and a second driving assembly is installed on the gear connecting piece; fixed mounting has the adapter sleeve on the gear connecting piece, and the one end threaded connection of adapter sleeve has the fastening knob, and adapter sleeve internally mounted has the electric welding, the utility model discloses can make things convenient for the seam welder body to carry out the position effectively and adjust, can conveniently carry out all-round welding to the plate like this and handle, and then make things convenient for device's use.

title: Positioning device of water hose for fire engineering
abstract: The utility model provides a positioning device of a water hose for fire engineering, which belongs to the technical field of fire engineering, and comprises a fire-fighting box body, a winding shaft and a limiting plate, wherein a chute is arranged on the inner side wall of a supporting frame, the top of the supporting frame is connected with a rack in a penetrating way, the bottom of the rack is fixedly connected with a fixed block, one side of the fixed block, which is close to the chute, is fixedly connected with a slider, the surface of the rack is meshed with a gear, the inside of the gear is fixedly connected with a second threaded rod, and one end of the second threaded; the utility model has good positioning effect, and can ensure that the fire hose can be stably kept in a rolling state when being stored by matching the positioning plate and the fixing block, thereby being convenient for achieving the purpose of fixedly positioning the fire hose; and be the ball that horizontal axis longitudinal symmetry set up in being provided with depression bar and the hosepipe export, can guarantee that fire hose can smooth and easy pull under the exogenic action, further improved its stability, reinforcing device's practicality.

title: Bioelectrode composition, bioelectrode, and method for producing bioelectrode
abstract: The present invention relates to a bioelectrode composition, a bioelectrode, and a method for producing a bioelectrodeThe manufacturing method comprises the following steps. The present invention addresses the problem of providing a bioelectrode composition that can form a bioelectrode contact layer for a bioelectrode that is flexible and has excellent flexibility and adhesiveness, is lightweight, can be produced at low cost, and has excellent electrical conductivity and biocompatibility, and does not significantly decrease in electrical conductivity even when wetted with water or dried. The invention provides a bioelectrode composition comprising (A) silicone; the (A) polysiloxane is bonded to an ionic polymer and has a structure containing a T unit represented by the following general formula (T1) (except a cage structure); (R) 0 SiO 3/2 ) (T1) wherein R 0 Is a linking group to the ionic polymer; and the ionic polymer is a polymer containing a repeating unit having a structure selected from the group consisting of ammonium salts, lithium salts, sodium salts, potassium salts, and silver salts of fluorosulfonic acid, fluorosulfonylimide, and N-carbonyl fluorosulfonamide.

title: Uv-curable composition, hard coat and hard coated article
abstract: The present invention relates to a UV-curable composition which comprises a combination of a (meth)acrylate-based curable resin composition, comprising one or more acrylate ester with 3 or more acrylate groups; and (meth)acrylate-based urethane or (meth)acrylate acid-based ester or (meth)acrylate-based epoxy or (meth)acrylate-based silicone oligomers; as well as a mixture of a compound having a perfluoropolyether (PFPE) group and a curable moiety; and a di(meth)acrylate monomer. In addition, the present invention relates to a hard coat which is obtainable by curing this composition, and a surface-treated article which includes the hard coat on one or more surfaces thereof, as well as a process for producing the article.

title: Cannabinoid and psychedelic formulations comprising hydrotropic agents
abstract: The present invention relates to application of hydrotropic agents in making water-soluble and super-fast disintegrating tablets, buccal tablets, or sublingual tablets containing either cannabinoid molecules or psychedelics molecules. This invention comprises of sublingual tablets disintegrating in less than one minute. One aspect of this invention contains a hydrotropic agents' composition to increase solubility of one or mixture of cannabinoid molecules. In this aspect, it may contain a cannabinoid composition comprising one or more cannabinoids molecules with or without presence of terpenes. It may also contain a disintegrant composition comprising of one or mixture of disintegrants. In another aspect, this invention contains one hydrotropic agent or a blend of hydrotropic agents to increase solubility of one or mixture of psychedelic molecules.

title: Curable silicone composition, cured product thereof, and method for producing same
abstract: The present invention provides a curable granular silicone composition and the like having excellent workability and curing characteristics such as hot-melt property and secondary molding, and providing a cured product having excellent flexibility and stress relaxation property and a small thermal expansion coefficient even when a large amount of filler is blended. A curable silicone composition comprising a polyorganosiloxane resin containing SiO in an amount of at least 20 mol% or more of all siloxane units, and one or more functional fillers, and use thereof 4/2 The siloxane unit(s) represented by (i) a vinyl group (CH) in a curing reactive functional group containing a carbon-carbon double bond per 100g of the silicone component in the composition 2 The content of the = CH-) moiety is 0.05 to 1.50 mol%, and the entire composition has a hot-melt property.

title: Composition, reactive diluent, curable composition, and method for producing composition
abstract: The present invention provides a composition which contains a specific diglycidyl ether, has a reduced total amount of chlorine, and has excellent insulation reliability. The present invention pertains to a composition which contains a chlorine-containing compound and a diglycidyl ether represented by formula (1), wherein the total amount of chlorine is 900 ppm or less. In formula (1), X represents an alkylene group having 9 to 11 carbon atoms.

title: Method of manufacturing jam using green tangerine and green tangerine jam prepared thereby
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a jam using a green tangerine and a green tangerine jam prepared by the method including: a freeze-dried green tangerine powder preparation step (S100) of preparing freeze-dried green tangerine powder by green tangerine preparation and freeze-drying; a mixing step (S200) of preparing a mixture by mixing the freeze-dried green tangerine powder with milk, oligosaccharide, pectin, stevia extract, pineapple concentrate, and whole milk powder; a stirring step (S300) of stirring the mixture in a mixer (S300); a heating step (S400) of heating and boiling the stirred mixture; and a cooling step (S500) of preparing a green tangerine jam by lemon juice and avocado oil addition to the boiled mixture, stirring, and cooling. By the jam preparation method of the present invention, it is possible to easily ingest the nutrients of green tangerines higher in vitamin C content than regular tangerines and satisfy health-oriented modern people's preferences.

title: Hydrogen supply system
abstract: A hydrogen supply system including: a plurality of hydrogen tanks that is attachable and detachable; a hydrogen consumption device that consumes hydrogen of the hydrogen tanks; and a control device is provided. The hydrogen consumption device includes an attaching-detaching mechanism including a plurality of motors that controls attaching and detaching of the hydrogen tanks with respect to the hydrogen consumption device, the motors corresponding to the attaching and detaching of the respective hydrogen tanks. The control device disposes, based on a temperature of each of the motors, a hydrogen tank of the hydrogen tanks to a hydrogen supply start position at which the hydrogen tank and the hydrogen consumption device are connected in a state in which the hydrogen tank is allowed to supply hydrogen to the hydrogen consumption device, or disposes the hydrogen tank to a hydrogen supply standby position.

title: Methods to impart color and durable properties to substrates
abstract: Metal substrates comprising a colored coating and/or a protective coating disposed on at least a surface of the substrate. The colored coating can include a metal oxide coating integrally bonded to the terminal and produced by heat tinting or a titanium nitride containing material. The protective coating is derived from a material comprising one or more of aluminum oxide, silicon oxide, a superhydrophobic material, wherein the protective coating has a Scratch Resistance of at least about F, as determined by ASTM D336. Methods of making and using the coated metal substrates are also disclosed.

title: Energy management system in industrial complex
abstract: The present invention is to provide an energy management system of an industrial complex which can provide an advanced energy management service and has enhanced security. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the energy management system of an industrial complex comprises: a plurality of individual consumers transmitting power data, energy data, and workplace data collected from a corresponding workplace; and a cloud server providing an energy management service analyzing an energy use pattern and a use status of the workplace corresponding to the plurality of individual consumers based on the power data, energy data, and workplace data transmitted from the plurality of individual consumers.

title: Remote sensing monitoring system for monitoring growth vigor of crops
abstract: The invention discloses a remote sensing monitoring system for monitoring the growth vigor of crops, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a data processing center, wherein a data acquisition module is loaded on the unmanned aerial vehicle, the data processing center is provided with a data storage module, a data preprocessing module and a data analysis module, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the data processing center are communicated through a wireless network, the data acquisition module comprises remote sensing image acquisition equipment and a universal tripod head system, the lower part of the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with an automatic tripod head connecting mechanism, the universal tripod head system is provided with a connecting column which penetrates through a bottom opening of the unmanned aerial vehicle and is inserted into the automatic tripod head connecting mechanism for connection, and the automatic tripod head connecting mechanism and the connecting column are automatically connected and locked through the taking-off and landing of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The universal holder system for loading different remote sensing image acquisition devices is automatically connected and replaced with the unmanned aerial vehicle through the taking-off and landing of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the replacement efficiency is high, and the problems of time-consuming overlong and human errors caused by field manual replacement are solved.
